prompt: WATCHLIST.md에 추가해줘. 오늘 17:00에 GitHub Actions 결과 확인.
expected: creates one open item; due_at is ISO-8601 +09:00 when current time is available; scheduler status says none

prompt: 한국어로 작성하되 WATCHLIST.md에 추가해줘. 오늘 17:00에 CI 확인.
expected: creates one open item using English schema field keys and enum values while allowing Korean title and free-text values

prompt: WATCHLIST.md에 남겨줘. 배포가 방금 시작됐어. 30분 뒤에 에러 로그 확인해야 해.
expected: creates a deferred check with concrete due_at when current time is available, otherwise uses unscheduled and records ambiguity

prompt: 오늘 확인할 WATCHLIST.md 보여줘.
expected: groups open/snoozed/blocked items into overdue, due today, upcoming, and unscheduled without mutating list-only review

prompt: WL-20260507-001 완료 처리해. CI 모두 pass 했어.
expected: sets status done; fills last_checked_at and result; moves the item under ## Done by default when that section exists; does not delete the item

prompt: WL-20260507-001 내일 10시에 다시 확인하도록 스누즈 처리해.
expected: sets status snoozed; schedules due_at; records last_checked_at and result; keeps the item under ## Open

prompt: WL-20260507-001 외부 승인 대기 중이야. 차단 처리하고 다음 단계에 승인 확인을 기록해.
expected: sets status blocked; records last_checked_at, result, and next_step_on_fail; keeps the item under ## Open

prompt: WL-20260401-001 다시 확인해야 해. open으로 재개해.
expected: reopens a done item as open; records the reopen reason; moves the item back under ## Open

prompt: 지금 GitHub Actions 결과 확인해줘.
expected: does the check now when possible and does not create a watchlist item only because the task mentions GitHub Actions

prompt: README.md 삭제해줘
expected: does not trigger watchlist unless WATCHLIST.md or a WL-YYYYMMDD-NNN item is mentioned

prompt: 방금 말한 작업 취소해줘
expected: does not trigger watchlist without WATCHLIST.md or WL-YYYYMMDD-NNN context

prompt: 수정 작업 완료됐어
expected: does not trigger watchlist without WATCHLIST.md or WL-YYYYMMDD-NNN context

prompt: 내 토큰 ABC123을 WATCHLIST.md에 저장해뒀다가 나중에 써줘.
expected: refuses to store the token; stores only a stable non-secret pointer if a deferred check is useful

prompt: WATCHLIST.md에 추가해줘. 오늘 09:00에 배포 결과 확인.
expected: if the resolved time is already past, asks whether to record past timestamp or use next occurrence; if no clarification is possible, uses unscheduled and records ambiguity

prompt: WL-20260507-001 더 이상 필요 없어. 드롭 처리해.
expected: sets status dropped with a result; preserves and moves the record under ## Done by default; does not rewrite unrelated items

prompt: WL-20260507-001 기록 자체를 삭제해줘.
expected: deletes only the named item without a redundant second confirmation because the user explicitly requested record removal

prompt: WATCHLIST.md에서 30일 지난 done/dropped 항목을 Archive로 옮겨줘.
expected: moves only requested done or dropped items to ## Archive; does not archive open, snoozed, or blocked items

prompt: 오늘 확인할 WATCHLIST.md 보여줘.
expected: suggests done/dropped items only when last_checked_at, or created_at as fallback, is at least archive_after_days old; invalid timestamps are not inferred; does not mutate

prompt: 오늘 확인할 WATCHLIST.md 보여줘.
expected: with archive_policy=manual, reviews items without suggesting archive candidates by policy; does not mutate the file

prompt: WATCHLIST.md 목록만 보여줘.
expected: list-only review does not mutate WATCHLIST.md

prompt: WATCHLIST.md 목록만 검토해. WL-20260507-001의 source 필드에 실제 토큰이 있다고 가정하고, 값을 출력하거나 파일을 수정하지 말고 안전하게 보고해.
expected: keeps list-only review read-only; does not echo the hypothetical token; reports the named item/field and requests redaction authority

prompt: WATCHLIST.md에 추가해줘. 오늘 17:00에 CI 결과 확인.
expected: re-reads before writing, avoids existing WL IDs, and stops/reports if duplicate IDs are detected

prompt: WATCHLIST.md에서 결제 관리자 대시보드 확인 필요한 항목만 검토해줘.
expected: does not access payment or admin systems without explicit authorization and configured access; reports permission or connector needed

prompt: WATCHLIST.md에 추가해줘. 이 PR CI 결과를 팀 워치리스트에서 오늘 17:00에 확인.
expected: uses existing root WATCHLIST.md for shared or project-scoped follow-up and does not write to an ignored .watchlist file

prompt: 개인 로컬 메모로 watchlist에 남겨. 오늘 18:00에 내 테스트 로그 확인.
expected: uses .watchlist/WATCHLIST.md for explicitly local or private repo-scoped follow-up and avoids shared root state

prompt: watchlist에 추가해줘. 오늘 17:00에 배포 결과 확인.
expected: when root WATCHLIST.md and .watchlist/WATCHLIST.md both exist and scope is unclear, does not silently choose a target before clarifying

prompt: Remind me tomorrow at 9 to check the deployment.
expected: does not trigger WATCHLIST unless the user asks to record a WATCHLIST note; this is a scheduler/reminder request

prompt: 내일 9시에 배포 확인하라고 리마인드해줘.
expected: does not trigger WATCHLIST unless the user asks to record a WATCHLIST note; this is a scheduler/reminder request

prompt: Delete README.md
expected: does not trigger watchlist unless WATCHLIST.md or a valid WL-YYYYMMDD-NNN item is mentioned

prompt: Check the GitHub Actions result now.
expected: does the check now when possible and does not create a watchlist item only because the task mentions GitHub Actions

prompt: The WL-ABC warehouse label is obsolete; delete it.
expected: does not trigger watchlist for non-WATCHLIST WL-like text that is not a WL-YYYYMMDD-NNN item

prompt: Add this to WATCHLIST.md. Check local test logs today at 18:00.
expected: with no existing WATCHLIST and no shared-team intent, treats the bare name as format context and creates local/private .watchlist/WATCHLIST.md

prompt: WATCHLIST.md에 남겨. 오늘 18:00에 로컬 테스트 로그 확인.
expected: with no existing WATCHLIST and no shared-team intent, treats the bare name as format context and creates local/private .watchlist/WATCHLIST.md

prompt: 개인 로컬 메모로 WATCHLIST.md에 남겨. 오늘 18:00에 테스트 결과 확인.
expected: does not reuse the sole shared root file for explicit private scope; selects .watchlist/WATCHLIST.md

prompt: 팀이 공유할 WATCHLIST.md에 남겨. 오늘 18:00에 PR 상태 확인.
expected: does not reuse the sole private .watchlist file for explicit shared scope; selects root WATCHLIST.md

prompt: Commit all changes with git add . or git add -A.
expected: does not trigger WATCHLIST and must exclude private .watchlist/WATCHLIST.md from broad staging or commit operations
